audit.why: EVEN / 6-10 with a 7/10 carry rating fits a lane Nautilus owns from level 2 to first item and loses after two, which is exactly what the prose describes. The 71.43% figure is 7 Emerald+ games and cannot move the rating on its own.
audit.corrected: No change to diff, tone, diffRating or carryRating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows named the wrong winner in BOTH layers. Rows 1, 2 and 5 said Kled and rows 3 and 4 said Skill, while every why on those rows is written in first person describing Nautilus winning.
audit.why: whys[1] 'I start winning short trades his Q-grab poke can't sustain'; whys[2] 'one chain wins the trade'; whys[3] 'I keep controlling the wave'; whys[4] 'my hardest spike'; whys[5] 'makes Q gank setups and W trades lethal'. Only whys[6] gives the stage to Kled. The packet flags the same contradiction against a 71.43% win rate, and the mirror audit flipped rows 3, 4 and 6 on its side to match.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Nautilus in matched full+content pairs (row 0 stays Skill, row 6 stays Kled), ratings re-scaled 7/10 through the mid-game and 4/10 at 2+ items, and all six why strings rewritten to state the real reason with cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Dredge Line's hard CC shuts off Kled's two dashes, never names Violent Tendencies as his burst tell, and twice recommends Grievous Wounds against a champion whose kit has no healing.
audit.why: enemyKit E (Jousting) and R (Chaaaaaaaarge!!!) both carry the dash flag — a landed Q-pull or the passive root stops either mid-cast, which the missingInteractions file flags as enemy-dash-deniable. enemyKit W carries the autoReset flag: 'massive attack speed for four attacks', the wind-up is the cue. Nothing in Kled's kit heals: Skaarl's courage restores his mount, it is not lifesteal, so 'his healing fights your grind' is steering the player into a wasted item slot.
audit.corrected: Jousting and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! named as CC-deniable in dosFull[0].d and report[5].t, Violent Tendencies named as the burst tell, Bear Trap's 11s rank-1 cooldown made the trade trigger, and the anti-heal advice replaced with armour in report[8].t and breakdown.late.

edits.before: Hook threat changes where he can stand forever. Only take the trade when Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kled must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — Q-pull into passive root into E slow pins him where he cannot reposition to remount Skaarl mid-chain.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1 — bait it, then run the full pull chain and zone him off farm; he cannot dismount out of your Q.

edits.before: Depth Charge is an unmissable point-click knockup — the all-in always starts. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Depth Charge is an unmissable knockup — fire it as he Q-grabs or rides Chaaaaaaaarge!!! in and the lockup lands mid-dash for a free kill window.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights now, while his base damage still has not out-scaled yours.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kled carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Kled out-scales you: courage stacking and remount sustain shred tank stats while your base damage flatlines. Play for picks.

edits.before: His engage hook. Q-peel it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1. CC him and Jousting is dead too.

edits.before: Track Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope: His engage hook. Q-peel it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Hold Q for his Jousting or Chaaaaaaaarge!!! — CC kills both dashes. Violent Tendencies is the tell.

notes: Nautilus's Q carries a derived 'projectile' flag but Riot's text only says colliding with an enemy pulls them together — whether a minion eats the hook is not in the kit, so no minion-block advice was written (same call the mirror made). Kled's dismounted Q becomes Pocket Pistol, a ranged knockback that restores courage; the page treats his Q as one spell throughout and never mentions the dismounted form's ranged poke. That is a real gap but filling it needs a length-neutral home I did not have — worth a follow-up.
